svg.title: Pastry Pirates — V2 · The Pixel World — Island shapes (7)
svg.desc: A jigsaw socket is cut into the middle of EVERY outside edge, so a dock can click onto any side of any square. Units: mm. 20 mm squares, 3 mm material. RASTER = black fill (engrave), CUT = red hairline (cut). Generated by physical-board/generate.mjs.
